ORC:4511.19.heading: OPERATING VEHICLE UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF ALCOHOL OR DRUGS – OVI 4511.19(A) ORC
FELONY OVI- (F-4) ORC 4511.19(G)(1)(d)
ORC:4511.19.variant: 3 OR 4 PRIOR CONVICTIONS WITHIN THE PAST 10 YEARS
ORC:4511.19.text: Operate a vehicle, to wit: (Year, Make, Tag: (State and number) at (location) while under the influence of alcohol, a drug of abuse, or a combination of them, and within (10 years) of the present offense, previously has been convicted of or pled guilty to (3 or more) violations of a similar state or municipal offense, to wit: (List conviction dates, court codes, case numbers, or prior offenses)

ORC:4511.19.heading: FELONY OVI- (F-4) ORC 4511.19(G)(1)(d)
ORC:4511.19.variant: 5 OR MORE PRIOR CONVICTIONS WITHIN THE PAST 20 YEARS
ORC:4511.19.text: Operate a vehicle, to wit: (Year, Make, Tag: (State and number) at (location) while under the influence of alcohol, a drug of abuse, or a combination of them, and within (20 years) of the present offense, previously has been convicted of or pled guilty to (5 or more) violations of a similar state or municipal offense, to wit: (List conviction dates, court codes, case numbers, or prior offenses)

ORC:4511.19.heading: FELONY OVI- (F-3) ORC 4511.19(G)(1)(e)
ORC:4511.19.variant: PRIOR FELONY OVI CONVICTION WITHIN LIFETIME (F3)
ORC:4511.19.text: Operate a vehicle, to wit: (Year, Make, Tag: (State and number) at (location) while under the influence of alcohol, a drug of abuse, or a combination of them, and having a prior felony OVI conviction or violations of a similar state or municipal offense, to wit: (List conviction dates, court codes, case numbers, or prior offenses)
